关键词: Results of Operations and Financial Condition
主要内容: The Walt Disney Company issued a press release on February 5, 2013, detailing its results for the quarter ended December 29, 2012. The report is part of a Form 8-K filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1 in the filing. The report outlines the company's financial performance and operational results for the quarter. The filing also includes the signature of Roger J. Patterson, the Associate General Counsel and Assistant Secretary of The Walt Disney Company, dated February 5, 2013.
